summary: Initializes the display formatter, then fetches a source object through the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface (slot +0x1C, command 8). If the source exists and the enable flag byte at this+0x100 is set, retrieves a value through the this vtable (slot +0xB4) and, after ZeroCheckGetter validates the source, iterates a global array from unk_7D1448 up to (but not including) flt_7D17A8, writing the retrieved value into each element's first dword and clamping it against bounds held in the element's third and fourth dwords. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call SetupValueDisplayFormatter on this to initialize display/dispatch state.
Fetch source object through virtual accessor at slot +0x1C of the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface, passing command 8.
Guard: proceed only if the source object is non-null.
Guard: proceed only if the enable flag byte at this+0x100 is non-zero.
Retrieve the value to clamp through the this vtable slot +0xB4 and dereference the returned pointer into v7.
Guard: proceed with the array loop only if ZeroCheckGetter validates the source object.
do-while loop over the global array starting at unk_7D1448, advancing 27 dwords per element, ending once the pointer reaches flt_7D17A8.
Write the retrieved value v7 into the current element's first dword.

Clamp the element value: if the element's third dword (lower bound) is at most the value, clamp down to the fourth dword (upper bound) when the value exceeds it; otherwise set the value to the third dword.

clean_pseudocode: float lo = p[2]; float hi = p[3];
